The Financial Analyst is responsible for supporting client's accounting function. Specifically, the Financial Analyst is responsible for maintaining general accounting functions related to interconnection billings and supporting cash, account receivable and accounts payable. People usually grow into this kind of accounting and billing work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0527.responsibilities:

Support the issuance of monthly interconnection bills to interconnection service developers, including gathering supporting documentation
As applicable, become a backup for month-end processes within the Controller Department.

BS (or working towards) in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration
Ability to efficiently use Microsoft Office Suite (MS-Word, MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint)

Equivalent working experience (0-5 years)
Preferred Requirements
SAP knowledge, specifically IM and PS modules
Knowledge of MS-Excel pivot tables
